introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure vulnerability-remediation tracking system for a university that manages findings from approved security assessment reports for servers, applications, endpoints, and network devices.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: Security analysts should be able to review findings, assign remediation tasks to authorized departmental administrators, record investigation notes, track remediation status, and close findings after reviewing submitted evidence.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The system should restrict access according to user roles, detect unauthorized changes to findings or remediation records, generate security alerts, and maintain audit logs of finding updates and administrator actions.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The platform should provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing university identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.

functional.applicability_reason: Independent source obligations; unspecified choices remain TBD.

requirements.title: manage findings from approved security assessment reports for servers, applications, endpoints, and network devices
requirements.statement: The system shall manage findings from approved security assessment reports for servers, applications, endpoints, and network devices.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system receives an approved security assessment report for a server
acceptance_criteria.when: the system manages the findings from that report
acceptance_criteria.then: the system returns a structured finding list with severity, location, and recommended remediation steps
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Security analysts to review findings
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security analysts to review findings.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security analysts review findings named in the request
acceptance_criteria.when: Security analysts initiate the review action
acceptance_criteria.then: The requested findings are returned for examination; an external test capture records the response
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow Security analysts to assign remediation tasks to authorized departmental administrators
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security analysts to assign remediation tasks to authorized departmental administrators.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security analysts assign remediation tasks to authorized departmental administrators
acceptance_criteria.when: Security analysts initiate the assignment operation
acceptance_criteria.then: The permission or access state for authorized departmental administrators is observed as active after Security analysts initiate the assignment operation.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow Security analysts to record investigation notes
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security analysts to record investigation notes.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security analysts perform a controlled instance of recording investigation notes
acceptance_criteria.when: Security analysts initiate the record operation
acceptance_criteria.then: The requested investigation note record is available for inspection; an external test capture records the inspection record
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

requirements.title: allow Security analysts to track remediation status
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security analysts to track remediation status.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security analysts track remediation status for a specific finding
acceptance_criteria.when: Security analysts initiate the tracking operation
acceptance_criteria.then: The named history of remediation status is available for examination; an external test capture records the resulting state
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow Security analysts to close findings after reviewing submitted evidence
requirements.statement: The system shall allow Security analysts to close findings after reviewing submitted evidence.

acceptance_criteria.given: Security analysts close findings after reviewing submitted evidence
acceptance_criteria.when: Security analysts initiate the closure action
acceptance_criteria.then: The finding is marked as closed; an external test capture records the updated status response
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: restrict access according to user roles
requirements.statement: The system shall restrict access according to user roles.

acceptance_criteria.given: system restricts access to resources based on user roles
acceptance_criteria.when: the system enforces role-based access control during resource retrieval
acceptance_criteria.then: The system enforces role-based access control during resource retrieval, and access to resources is restricted according to user roles.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: detect unauthorized changes to findings or remediation records
requirements.statement: The system shall detect unauthorized changes to findings or remediation records.

acceptance_criteria.given: system monitors changes to findings or remediation records
acceptance_criteria.when: an unauthorized modification is attempted on a finding or remediation record
acceptance_criteria.then: the system detects and logs the change as unauthorized
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define the requested detections and their alert triggers?

requirements.title: generate security alerts
requirements.statement: The system shall generate security alerts.

acceptance_criteria.given: system generates security alerts under defined conditions
acceptance_criteria.when: a predefined alert condition is initiated by a threat or anomaly event
acceptance_criteria.then: a security alert exists in the designated alerting system with required fields populated
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: maintain audit logs of finding updates and administrator actions
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain audit logs of finding updates and administrator actions.

acceptance_criteria.given: system maintains audit logs for finding updates and administrator actions
acceptance_criteria.when: an update to a finding or an administrative action is performed
acceptance_criteria.then: The system maintains audit logs for finding updates and administrator actions, as evidenced by external test capture of the inspection record.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

unresolved_decisions: Which fields must the audit logs contain?
What retention period is required for the audit logs?

requirements.title: provide a centralized dashboard
requirements.statement: The system shall provide a centralized dashboard.

acceptance_criteria.given: a controlled user opens the source-named dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: the system provides a centralized dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard is displayed or available for use
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: integrate with existing university identity services
requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with existing university identity services.

acceptance_criteria.given: a controlled user initiates an identity service exchange with the university identity services
acceptance_criteria.when: the system integrates with existing university identity services
acceptance_criteria.then: interoperation with the external service is observed
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: support multiple campus locations
requirements.statement: The system shall support multiple campus locations.

acceptance_criteria.given: a controlled user initiates use from each stated campus location
acceptance_criteria.when: the system supports multiple campus locations
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the inspection record

assumptions: These are defensive planning hypotheses, not observed incidents or approved extra controls. Unrecognized threats and actual implementation effectiveness require human review.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting User identities and authenticated access: Unauthorized use of a legitimate identity could expose resources or alter system state.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: An attacker uses a compromised identity or authenticated session to impersonate an authorized user and exercise that user's permitted operations.
risks.mitigation: Review impersonation and compromised-identity paths against the stated access duties; confirm any additional identity or session protections with the stakeholder. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Role and permission boundaries: A lower-privilege user could access restricted functions or sensitive resources.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: A principal exploits an incorrect role assignment or permission check to perform operations outside the source-defined authorization boundary.
risks.mitigation: Test permitted and denied role/resource pairs against the linked authorization duties; review ambiguous permission assignments with the resource owner. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Monitoring and security alerts: Relevant suspicious activity could remain undetected or receive delayed investigation.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: Suspicious activity evades the source-defined detection workflow, or excessive events obscure actionable alerts before an authorized reviewer can investigate.
risks.mitigation: Evaluate the stated detection duties with representative positive and negative events; confirm undecided thresholds, alert priorities and investigation responsibilities. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Integration trust paths: Untrusted integration data could cause incorrect decisions or hide security events.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: A compromised connected system or integration path supplies forged, altered or missing identity, event or policy data used by the source-defined integration.
risks.mitigation: Review trust assumptions at the specified integration boundaries with missing or altered input fixtures; confirm the required failure handling with the owner. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Security and administrative audit evidence: Investigators could lose reliable evidence of the events required by the brief.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: An attacker or recording failure suppresses or alters source-required audit evidence so that access decisions, security events or admin actions cannot be reconstructed.
risks.mitigation: Compare source-required events with the resulting audit evidence; assess missing and altered-record cases and confirm unprovided protection or retention decisions. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.
